newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT sees improved profits over H1.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT sees improved profits over H1.

text.p: Dutch paper, office supplies and printing equipment group NV Koninklijke KNP BT said on Thursday it was maintaining its forecast of a slight rise in second half net profits.

"Given that the fourth quarter is seasonally the best for KNP BT, we maintain our earlier forecast that the net result over the second half of the year will be slightly higher than in the first half," the company said in a statement.
KNP BT said in July it saw an improved second half. In the first half of 1996, net profits from ordinary operations plunged by 64 percent to 101 million guilders.
